ideas.title: Game saves: slot manager, backups, quick save from the trainer
ideas.desc:
Save list with date and location, backup before overwriting, load/save with one click.

Technical note: first we need a reliable save address (CGameManager::Write_Savegame) for 1.08k.

ideas.title: Quest log: view and change quest status
ideas.desc: List of quests from the log, set: running / success / failed, help when a quest gets stuck.

ideas.title: Story variables and chapters: view and edit
ideas.desc: Browser for script variables (e.g. who already said something), change values, warnings about what may break the story.
